The provided text highlights that while vegetarian and vegan diets are often confused, they differ primarily in their level of restriction regarding animal products. Vegetarians abstain from meat but may still consume dairy and eggs, whereas vegans exclude all animal-derived items, including honey and gelatin. Despite these differences in dietary scope, both diets share common motivations, stemming from health, ethical, or environmental concerns.

Regarding your priority question: Pearls are typically found in mollusks, specifically within the shells of oysters and mussels.
